watches.name: TWCO. Lumecore Chronograph
watches.description: The TWCO. Lumecore Chronograph MKII embodies the core principles of Tool Watch Co., utility, simplicity, and considered design. Thoughtfully refined in response to feedback from our global enthusiast community, the MKII preserves everything that made the original our best-selling chronograph while introducing meaningful improvements for enhanced everyday wear. Its stripped-back 38mm case, high-gloss fully lumed dial, and contrasting skeletonized matte black hands deliver exceptional legibility while maintaining a balanced neo-vintage aesthetic.

watches.name: TWCO. Lumecore GMT
watches.description: The TWCO. Lumecore GMT embodies the core principles of Tool Watch Co., utility and simplicity, while evolving the Lumecore collection into a fully mechanical travel watch. This limited-production timepiece blends bold, modern aesthetics with practical functionality through its stripped-back case, fully lumed high-gloss dial, skeletonized matte black hands, and rugged True GMT movement.

watches.name: TWCO. AMA Diver Limited Edition
watches.description: The green mother of pearl dial AMA is limited to 150 timepieces worldwide with a numbered caseback. The AMA Diver is a robust, technical timepiece depth rated to 300m with a precise 120-click unidirectional bezel and draws inspiration from the Ama’s 2000-year-old pearl diving tradition.

watches.description: The Arctic One of Ten is limited to ten timepieces worldwide. watches.name: TWCO. Essential Chronograph
watches.description: The TWCO. Essential Chronograph represents Tool Watch Co.'s core approach: a stripped-back design that emphasizes the essentials, utility, craftsmanship, and quality. As part of our permanent collection, this timepiece combines modern functionality with durability.

watches.name: TWCO. Goodman GMT Tactical
watches.description: The Goodman GMT Tactical is built around a brushed matte PVD coated stainless steel case with an integrated fixed 24 hour bezel and a matching PVD buckle. A clean no date dial houses the True GMT Miyota 9075 mechanical movement, complemented by bi color C3 lume, a double domed box acrylic crystal, and a black FKM strap. Its restrained, tactical aesthetic draws inspiration from the darker tones and shaded landscapes of California’s national parks.

watches.name: TWCO. Goodman GMT Utility
watches.description: The Goodman GMT features a brushed stainless-steel case with an integrated fixed 24-hour bezel, the True GMT Miyota 9075 mechanical movement, bi-color C3 lume, a double-domed box acrylic crystal, and a durable FKM rubber strap. The dune-tone dial is inspired by the muted earth colors of the Californian outdoors and is paired with a 6 o’clock date window for practical daily timing.
